# Crest Matrix Digital Group

> E-commerce growth agency from Nigeria, led by founder Akingbola Taiwo, serving Shopify brands worldwide since 2021. Focus: landing pages for Meta ads, conversion optimization, technical SEO and Klaviyo email.

Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success score. Free written store review available on request.
